critical_issues.msg: Variable `usersData` is referenced but never defined; `useUsers` is imported and called via `useTasks` but its result is stored in an undefined variable.
critical_issues.suggestion: Add `const { data: usersData } = useUsers(1, 100);` alongside the `useTasks` call on line 45, or destructure it there.

critical_issues.msg: `filteredAndSorted` is a plain function called on every render (lines 117, 118, 137, 138) without memoization, causing O(n log n) re-sorting on each render and inconsistent state between calls within the same render.
critical_issues.suggestion: Wrap with `useMemo(() => filteredAndSorted(), [items, priorityFilter, assigneeFilter, createdAfter, createdBefore, sortKey, sortDir])` and rename to `displayed` (deduplicating the existing `displayed` variable).

critical_issues.msg: Drag-end status update silently swallows errors with an empty catch block; the user receives no feedback if the API call fails.
critical_issues.suggestion: Log the error or call a toast/notification utility inside the catch block so the user knows the move failed.

critical_issues.msg: Form state is initialized once at mount from `task` prop; if the parent passes a different `task` (e.g., after opening a different task in the modal), the form will not update — it will show stale data.
critical_issues.suggestion: Add `task` to the `useEffect` dependency array so form resets when `task` changes, or derive form directly from `task` with `useEffect` mirroring the initial setup.

critical_issues.msg: `Shield` is used in `crmItems` (line 29) but is not imported from lucide-react; `Upload` is used in `systemItems` (line 36) but is not imported — both will cause runtime `ReferenceError` when the sidebar renders.
critical_issues.suggestion: Add `Shield` and `Upload` to the lucide-react import on line 9.

critical_issues.msg: Rule 5 / Service Convention: 'tenant_id: int = 0' violates the rule that services require tenant_id — it has a default value and allows 0 as a sentinel, bypassing multi-tenancy.
critical_issues.suggestion: Remove the default: 'tenant_id: int' with no default value. Callers must always supply it explicitly.

critical_issues.msg: Rule 100 / Calling convention mismatch: get_task is called as svc.get_task(tenant_id, task.id) — positional args where the second positional arg (task.id) lands in the task_id parameter but tenant_id is unnamed. This works today but any reordering of get_task's signature would break silently.
Rule 100: update_task called as svc.update_task(tenant_id, tid, ...) with positional args — same pattern as line 259, fragile to signature changes.
Rule 100: complete_task called as svc.complete_task(tenant_id, tid) with positional args — same fragility issue.
Rule 100: delete_task called as svc.delete_task(tenant_id, tid) with positional args — same fragility issue.

Rule 100: list_tasks called as svc.list_tasks(tenant_id) with only one positional arg — the signature is list_tasks(tenant_id, assigned_to, status, page, page_size), so this passes tenant_id to the assigned_to parameter and relies on defaults for the rest.
Unreachable `return MockResult([])` immediately after `return MockResult([...])` in task_handler INSERT block — line 882 can never execute.
critical_issues.suggestion: Delete line 882. The INSERT branch already returns at line 862.

critical_issues.msg: task_handler (used by all_handlers) implements only INSERT and SELECT; UPDATE and DELETE for tasks are not handled. Integration tests that call PATCH /api/v1/tasks/{id} or DELETE /api/v1/tasks/{id} will get MockResult([]) from the catch-all, causing downstream test failures.
critical_issues.suggestion:
Add UPDATE and DELETE branches to task_handler, e.g.:
  if sql_text.startswith('update') and 'tasks' in sql_text: ...
  if sql_text.startswith('delete') and 'tasks' in sql_text: ...

suggestions.msg: POST /api/v1/tasks endpoint is described with no response status code, while other endpoints have explicit codes — inconsistent with the acceptance criteria stating 201.
suggestions.suggestion: Add 'returns 201' to the POST endpoint description to match the acceptance criteria on line 68.

suggestions.msg: Plan references removing redundant per-status API calls but doesn't account for the tradeoff: fetching all tasks with no filter to compute counts may be costlier than dedicated status-count endpoints for large datasets.
suggestions.suggestion: Clarify that the full dataset fetch (useTasks(1, "")) is acceptable given expected task volume, or consider a dedicated counts endpoint as a future optimization.

suggestions.msg: Plan says 'the backend TaskModel stores them via extra fields or a relation' — this ambiguous wording could lead to inconsistent implementations where customer_id/opportunity_id are added differently in the model vs. the API.
suggestions.suggestion: Specify exactly how customer_id and opportunity_id are stored on the backend (e.g. nullable columns on TaskModel) before frontend work begins.

suggestions.msg: SKILL.md Don't list says 'Return ApiResponse from services' but the authoritative CLAUDE.md does not mention ApiResponse in its Do/Don't checklist, risking divergence if only CLAUDE.md is consulted.
suggestions.suggestion: Add a reference in SKILL.md to the project-specific rules section in CLAUDE.md, or add ApiResponse to CLAUDE.md's Do/Don't list explicitly.

suggestions.msg: Reference file paths listed in the table (e.g. references/service.md) cannot be verified — no such files appear in the codebase, and reading them will silently fall back to no-op.
suggestions.suggestion: Verify that references/service.md, references/router.md, references/unit_tests.md, references/integration_tests.md, and references/migrations.md exist. If they don't, remove the table or create the files.

suggestions.msg: No issues found. Dependencies are pinned with caret ranges, dnd-kit and react-markdown are present as planned, and test tooling (vitest, testing-library, jsdom) is included.
suggestions.suggestion: No fix needed.

suggestions.msg: useUpdateTask is imported and assigned but never used in the component — dead code clutters the module and may indicate a missing feature or accidental import.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the unused `update = useUpdateTask()` line, or wire it up if bulk-update from this layout context is intended.

suggestions.msg: useEffect dependency array contains sidebarOpen which is also the state being set inside the effect body — this creates a confusing dependency that ESLint will flag as a rule-of-hooks or exhaustive-deps violation.
suggestions.suggestion: Move the setSidebarOpen(false) outside the effect and restructure: either use a different trigger (e.g. just pathname change) or eliminate the effect entirely if the intent is just to close the sidebar on navigation.

suggestions.msg: Empty catch block silently swallows all errors from create.mutateAsync — error is 'handled by the mutation hook' but the comment is misleading since errors would typically trigger the onError callback, not the hook itself.
suggestions.suggestion: Either remove the try/catch entirely (let errors propagate to the hook's error state) or log the error: console.error('Task creation failed', err). The current empty catch obscures debugging.

suggestions.msg: localStorage read in useState initializer runs on the server during SSR — Next.js 13+ App Router disables client-side checks by default so this may not crash, but the pattern is fragile if the file is ever moved or Next.js config changes.
suggestions.suggestion: Use a lazy initialization pattern or read localStorage only inside a useEffect to guarantee it only runs in the browser context.

suggestions.msg: `filteredAndSorted()` call inside `toggleSelectAll` is not memoized, so sorting re-runs on every checkbox toggle.
suggestions.suggestion: Use the memoized `displayed` value instead of calling the function directly.

suggestions.msg: `colSpan={7}` does not match the actual column count (6 columns: checkbox, Title, Status, Priority, Due Date, Created), causing a malformed table layout.
suggestions.suggestion: Change `colSpan={7}` to `colSpan={6}` on lines 239, 240, and 241.

suggestions.msg: Pagination summary hardcodes page size as 20; if the API returns a different `page_size`, the 'Showing X–Y' text will be incorrect.
suggestions.suggestion: Use `info.page_size` from the API response instead of the hardcoded literal 20.

suggestions.msg: `isDragging` state is declared and updated but never read — the drag-overlay and column opacity use `update.isPending` instead.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the `isDragging` state declaration, or use it (e.g., remove `update.isPending` in favor of `isDragging`).

suggestions.msg: `useTasks` is called with only `tasksPage` and `tasksSearch`, bypassing status/priority/assignee filters that the list page exposes, making the Kanban board show all tasks regardless of filters.
suggestions.suggestion: Pass all filter arguments to `useTasks` or accept this as intentionally unfiltered for the Kanban view (document the difference).

suggestions.msg: `useEffect` with empty deps `[]` checks `!task && initialStatus` every render due to missing `task` and `initialStatus` in the dependency array, producing the eslint-disable for exhaustive-deps.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the `useEffect` entirely — `form.status` is already initialized with `initialStatus ?? 'pending'` on line 52, making this effect a no-op for the initial render.

suggestions.msg: Customer search nests an HTML `<input>` directly inside `<SelectContent>`, which is an a11y anti-pattern (interactive elements inside selects are not announced by screen readers).
suggestions.suggestion: Use a separate Popover + Combobox pattern (e.g., @dnd-kit's combobox or a custom autocomplete) for customer search instead of nesting inputs in SelectContent.

suggestions.msg: `Activity` is imported from lucide-react twice in the same import statement (line 9 shows it listed, and line 7 also lists it), which is redundant.
suggestions.suggestion: Deduplicate the `Activity` import into a single occurrence.

suggestions.msg: `isActive` uses `pathname.startsWith(href + '/')` which will match `/tasks` when visiting `/tasks/customers`, but a deeper path like `/tasks` should not activate `/tasks-board`; the prefix check is slightly loose for exact-route items like `/settings`.
suggestions.suggestion: For leaf routes (settings, analytics, etc.) use strict equality; for parent routes use `startsWith`. Consider splitting `crmItems` into exact and prefix-matched groups.

suggestions.msg: useSearchCustomers uses a raw query key ["customers", "search", keyword] instead of the centralized qk utility, breaking query-key consistency.
suggestions.suggestion: Add useSearchCustomers to qk (e.g. searchCustomers: (keyword: string) => ["customers", "search", keyword]) and reference it here.

suggestions.msg: useActivity uses a raw query key ["activity", id] instead of the centralized qk utility.
suggestions.suggestion: Add activity: (id: number) => ["activity", id] to qk and reference it here.

suggestions.msg: useReminders lacks a typed ApiEnvelope generic on apiClient.get, unlike every other query hook in this file.
suggestions.suggestion: Add the generic: apiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<Record<string, unknown>>>("/api/v1/reminders?...", ...)

suggestions.msg: ApiEnvelope.data is typed as PaginatedResponse<T> but single-entity responses (e.g. useCustomer, useTask) also use ApiEnvelope — their data shape is not actually paginated.
suggestions.suggestion: Consider a separate ApiSingleResponse<T> interface where data: T (not paginated) for get-by-id endpoints, to align the type with actual API shape.

suggestions.msg: useTasks constructs a queryKey with only page and status via qk.tasks, but the hook also filters by priority, assigned_to, createdAfter, createdBefore — meaning queries with different filter values will share a cache key and return stale data.
suggestions.suggestion: Extend qk.tasks to include all filter params and pass them to the qk call, e.g. qk.tasks(page, status, priority, assigned_to, createdAfter, createdBefore).

suggestions.msg: useActivities queryKey only includes page and type but not page_size, though the implementation hardcodes page_size=20 — this is fine but slightly misleading given other hooks expose page_size as a parameter.
suggestions.suggestion: Either expose page_size as a parameter in useActivities or remove it from consideration here.

suggestions.msg: afterEach calls vi.restoreAllMocks() after every test, but vi.mock is module-level and the per-test beforeEach already resets store state — restoring all mocks is unnecessary overhead.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the afterEach block entirely; it provides no value given beforeEach already isolates test state via setState.

suggestions.msg: Mutable default argument initialStatus = 'pending' is a JavaScript antipattern — while primitives are safe here, the pattern is easy to get wrong if the default is later changed to an object or array (Rule 22).
suggestions.suggestion: Normalize the default inside the function body: open: (initialStatus?: string) => set({ isOpen: true, initialStatus: initialStatus ?? 'pending' })

suggestions.msg: Clean aggregator module that correctly imports and re-exports all feature routers with a proper __all__ list; no issues found.
UNASSIGNED = 0 is a module-level constant but 0 is not self-documenting; it's effectively a magic number.
suggestions.suggestion: Use a named constant from the models layer (e.g. from db.models.task import UNASSIGNED_ID) or document why 0 is the sentinel.

suggestions.msg: Body.assigned_to=0 is falsy so the `or UNASSIGNED` fallback is a no-op and obscures intent; explicit None-check reads clearer.
suggestions.suggestion: Use `assigned_to=body.assigned_to if body.assigned_to is not None else UNASSIGNED` for clarity.

suggestions.msg: Rule 110: 'automation_router' imported but its inclusion (line 108) is preceded by a blank line — likely auto-generated or added after the rest; verify it is actually used and not dead code.
suggestions.suggestion: Confirm automation_router is not a stub. If it's intentionally included, the blank line before it (line 107) is inconsistent with the rest of the block.

suggestions.msg: Rule 123: create_task calls both flush() and refresh() — this is the flush+refresh+commit triple pattern that fights the router-owned transaction lifecycle.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the refresh() call. The router dependency commits, and flush() already populates auto-generated IDs. If you need the returned object with IDs, rely on the ORM object already in memory after flush().

suggestions.msg: Rule 31: list_tasks executes two separate SQL queries (SELECT + COUNT) — each with near-identical WHERE conditions built manually.
suggestions.suggestion: Use a single query with window function (OVER) to compute total alongside results, or at least share the built conditions between the two statements rather than duplicating the condition-building logic.

suggestions.msg: Rule 63: test_list_tasks has a shared-tenant assertion (total >= 2) that can be flaky if other tests run in the same session and create tasks for different suffixes.
suggestions.suggestion: Add a tenant_id filter or status filter to list_tasks call so the test is isolated to its own data. Use a unique status value or a named assigned_to user so cross-test pollution cannot affect the assertion.

suggestions.msg: Rule 110: 'from pkg.errors.app_exceptions import NotFoundException' is imported locally inside test_workflow_execute_not_found but already imported at module level on line 17 — unnecessary re-import.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the local import on line 110 and rely on the module-level import.

suggestions.msg: test_task_lifecycle accepts tenant_id_web: int parameter but never references it, making the parameter dead weight.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove `tenant_id_web: int` from the method signature, or use it to assert cross-tenant isolation within the lifecycle test.

suggestions.msg: MockTask.__init__ uses mutable default argument `data=None` then calls setattr on it, risking cross-instance contamination if the same dict reference is reused by a caller.
suggestions.suggestion: Change signature to `def __init__(self, data=None):` with `data = data if data is not None else {}` inside the body.

suggestions.msg: All tests in this file mock TaskService entirely (no DB), so they only exercise HTTP-layer validation (status codes, schema validation) — not service or SQL logic. Tests in tests/integration/ cover the actual DB path.
suggestions.suggestion: No fix needed — this is intentional, but reviewers should be aware the unit tests here do not exercise TaskService or database code.

issues.message: useEffect dependency array contains sidebarOpen which is also the state being set inside the effect body — this creates a confusing dependency that ESLint will flag as a rule-of-hooks or exhaustive-deps violation.
issues.suggestion: Move the setSidebarOpen(false) outside the effect and restructure: either use a different trigger (e.g. just pathname change) or eliminate the effect entirely if the intent is just to close the sidebar on navigation.

issues.message: Empty catch block silently swallows all errors from create.mutateAsync — error is 'handled by the mutation hook' but the comment is misleading since errors would typically trigger the onError callback, not the hook itself.

issues.message: localStorage read in useState initializer runs on the server during SSR — Next.js 13+ App Router disables client-side checks by default so this may not crash, but the pattern is fragile if the file is ever moved or Next.js config changes.
issues.suggestion: Use a lazy initialization pattern or read localStorage only inside a useEffect to guarantee it only runs in the browser context.

parsed.summary: Layout component is functional and integrates the quick-add TaskModal correctly, but contains a dead import, a misleading useEffect dependency, an empty catch block, and a fragile localStorage read during SSR.

issues.message: Variable `usersData` is referenced but never defined; `useUsers` is imported and called via `useTasks` but its result is stored in an undefined variable.
issues.suggestion: Add `const { data: usersData } = useUsers(1, 100);` alongside the `useTasks` call on line 45, or destructure it there.

issues.suggestion: Wrap with `useMemo(() => filteredAndSorted(), [items, priorityFilter, assigneeFilter, createdAfter, createdBefore, sortKey, sortDir])` and rename to `displayed` (deduplicating the existing `displayed` variable).

issues.message: `filteredAndSorted()` call inside `toggleSelectAll` is not memoized, so sorting re-runs on every checkbox toggle.
issues.suggestion: Use the memoized `displayed` value instead of calling the function directly.
